content.comment_body: Good morning everyone, I'm currently working on a project that requires three analog inputs for my [product_name] PLC. In the analog settings, I've enabled all four analog inputs, but it seems that I can't proceed unless an additional fourth input is added. Is there a way to configure only three analog inputs? I've connected the three sensors (0-10V current sensors) to I7, I8, and I1. I also tried bridging the input from I1 to I2 and connecting I2 to ground in an attempt to make the system recognize only three analog inputs, but neither solution worked. I would prefer not to rewire the dozen panels I already have set up. Any suggestions would be appreciated. Thank you.

I'm not quite sure how the cabling relates to the twelve panels you mentioned, but let's focus on the input setup for now. Which [product_name] [version_no] are you using specifically? Not every [product_name] version comes with analog input capability. Only certain models include analog inputs, while others do not. When you enable all four analog inputs in the configuration settings, it simply reserves addresses for AI1 to AI4 on the base module. Whether you use I1, I2, I7, or I8 as analog or digital inputs is up to your configuration and doesn't depend on this reservation.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face difficulty when setting up analog inputs on [product_name] [version_no], particularly wanting to utilize only three analog channels instead of the standard four. The interface appears to require activation of all four inputs, causing users to try workaround solutions that aren't effective. Misunderstandings around configuration, as well as lack of clear guidance on input assignment, lead to user frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to configure exactly three analog inputs without the need to activate all four or make changes to existing wiring layouts, seeking a simple solution for the requirements of their application.
